## Highlights
### Improved
- Identify tabs with their own side panels by an extension badge on the favicon, including pinned tabs
### Fixed
- Keep page addresses and sign-in cookies private when discovering site icons, and stop oversized icon downloads early - Extension regrouping no longer leaves empty current folders behind, and orange groups are easier to distinguish from yellow - Signed-in extension panels use isolated sessions with tighter cookie protections for other sites and Spaces - Prevent a crash when an idle extension wakes while its side panel remains open - Text replacement follows your Mac settings and keeps your choice when Crest restarts - Keep tab-specific extension panels with their own pages and restore each panel when returning to its tab - Extension screenshots capture the selected page correctly - Firefox sidebars follow the selected tab, and extension panels close reliably without affecting other tabs - Keep side-panel sign-in links in their original Space when you switch Spaces - Keep Space customization when edits overlap an iCloud sync, and preserve saved crest controls when switching designs
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.
